猎杀修士（猎杀修士（第22页）这件事情，王琳已经从鲁冉冉的口中慢慢的得知了，果然跟她猜测的一样，夏天和宋新月之间出现了一些误会。同时呼的单手就抓起两人之间的桌子，灰熊丟桃一样，毫不费力的将整张桌子一个翻身，带着空气的急剧流动，瞬间将桌子立起来，同时往靠街边窗户一捂。“陆明？！这不是陆明吗！”少年指着刚从商场走出来的陆明，嘴巴张的老大。娱记却不会满足于这模糊的回答，他们需要的是话题，可以引爆民众八卦之心的话题。叶云看到床上男人的侧脸，认出来他正是镇长钱双贺。白天叶云有在镇上看到他的照片，一眼就认出来了。纳兰清在一旁耐性地等他们二人先相认，她清楚毒圣子的怪脾性，不敢惹他不乐意耽误了自己拿生骨花。看到易枫为了自己不惜真气，现在已经煞白并疲惫的脸色，白狐的心就一阵的难过，自己只是个废人。奥克帝国的席位中，蓝威狠狠地叹了口气，表情极度漠然，虽然他早就想到会是这个结果，但是当这个结局真正来临的时候，蓝威还是感觉自己心中空荡荡的，好似丢了什么珍贵的东西一般。“龙公子还真是聪明，不错，排名第二的天才人物正是我哥，极南域卢家的卢子航！”卢子琳一脸自豪地说道。晨曦划破天际，昭示着新一天的到来，在草地上打坐入定的六人相继睁开了眼睛。“嘿嘿，两位兄弟不要客气，虽然我是你们的掌门，但你们还不认识我，正所谓不知者无罪，都起来吧。”叶天也不是那种爱摆架子的人。想着距离这届的国内选拔大会还至少有半年时间，对于天才而言，半年时间说长不长，但是说短也不见得就短，谁又能保证半年之后，这个少年不能出乎所有人的意料。中午，我随便地在食堂点了一杯橙汁与一份水果沙拉和朋友一起坐在了花园的石凳上。大长老的目光中闪烁着冰冷，这些敢挑衅学院尊严的人必须收到惩罚。一股强大的冲击力既刻爆发，将会狼震飞了出去，就连稍远一点的紫研也后退了数步。

Wang Lin has slowly learned about the matter of hunting monks (Hunting monks (page 22)) from Lu Ranran. As she guessed, there was some misunderstanding between Xia Tian and Song Xinyue. At the same time, she grabbed the table between the two with one hand, and effortlessly threw it away like a grizzly bear throwing a peach. The whole table turned over, with a sudden flow of air, and the table stood up in an instant, and at the same time he covered the window near the street. "Lu Ming?! Isn't this Lu Ming!" The young man pointed at Lu Ming, who had just walked out of the mall, but the boss who opened his mouth was not satisfied with this vague answer. They needed it. It was a topic that could arouse people's gossip. Ye Yun saw the profile of the man on the bed and recognized him as the mayor Qian Shuanghe. Ye Yun saw his photo in the town and recognized him at a glance. Nalan Qing waited patiently for the two of them to recognize each other first. She knew the strange temper of Du Shengzi. Not wanting to offend him, he delayed himself in getting the raw bone flower. Seeing Yi Feng's pale and tired face, he felt sad that he was just a useless person. In the seat of the Oak Empire, Lan Wei sighed hard, with an extremely indifferent expression, although he had already thought of it. This will be the result, but when the ending really comes, Lan Wei still feels empty in his heart, as if he has lost something precious. "Young Master Long is really smart, yes, the second most talented person is my brother, Lu Zihang from the Lu family in the Extreme South Region!" Lu Zilin said with a look on her face. He said proudly. The morning light broke through the sky, signaling the arrival of a new day. The six people who were meditating on the grass opened their eyes one after another. "Hey, brothers, don't be polite. Although I am your leader, you don't know me yet. As the saying goes, those who don't know are not guilty, so get up." A person who likes to put on airs. Thinking that there is still at least half a year before this domestic selection meeting. For a genius, half a year is not long, but it is not necessarily short. Who can guarantee that after half a year, this boy will not exceed everyone's expectations. At noon, I casually ordered in the cafeteria. A glass of orange juice and a fruit salad sat on the stone bench in the garden with friends. The great elder's eyes flashed with coldness. Those who dared to provoke the dignity of the academy must be punished. A powerful impact immediately erupted, sending the wolf flying, and even Ziyan who was a little further away took a few steps back.
